_comments: CALIBRATED against REAL captured frames of OWCS 2026 | NA/EMEA | Stage 2

At ~40:24 the broadcast is on a match intro / map-pick screen (Geekay
Esports left vs a Twisted Minds-style pink-fist logo right, 'Lower
Final', 'FT3', pick/ban icons) — confirmed NOT live gameplay. The first
confirmed live-HUD gameplay window found is 0:41:00–0:41:30 (frames at
41:00, 41:10, 41:20 all show both team HUD rows with all 10 hero
portraits) — slots_a/slots_b below are calibrated from that window.
This VOD only reliably section-downloads as the 640x360 progressive
format (itag 18) — the h264/VP9/AV1 DASH video-only formats (itags
135/298/299/etc.) either stall or 403 on --download-sections for this
video specifically (confirmed by direct probing), so run_owcs_auto.py's
fallback ladder always lands on 640x360 here even with --height 1080.
Slot boxes were therefore measured in 640x360 pixel space (chip/portrait
cell edges located by HSV color-cluster detection on the ability-charge
chips + a distinctive saturated-yellow portrait used as a cross-check
anchor) and stored below at an exact 3x scale (1920x1080), so
scale_layout_to_frame maps them back to 640x360 losslessly at runtime.
Given the source resolution, boxes are a close hug on each portrait but
not sub-pixel precise — re-verify if a higher-resolution capture of this
VOD ever becomes downloadable.
